# Inspecto Telco — brochure

*Audience: customers, presales and sales. Prices are not published here. Product Map Item [`product.telco`](index.md) · a Domain product for the Telecom Industry.*

> **Find revenue leakage and fraud in your network's records, see who is linked to whom, and work every case to a decision.**

## What it is

Revenue Assurance, Fraud Management, Link Analysis and Case Management in one product for your network's records.

## Apps

- **[Revenue Assurance](../../app/telco-ra/index.md)** (required) — Compare switch, mediation, rating and billing, and see every break they leave. Follow completeness, leakage found and leakage recovered over time.
- **[Case Management](../../app/case-management/index.md)** (required) — Every Alert the Apps raise, newest first, with the Incident it opened. Triage, assign and resolve what the Alerts opened, with its impact. Group related Incidents into one Case and work it to a decision.
- **[Fraud Management](../../app/telco-fraud/index.md)** (optional) — See which lines score highest for SIM-box and bypass, and which factors raised them. Find lines whose usage moves away from their own history.
- **[Link Analysis](../../app/link-analysis/index.md)** (optional) — Investigate how entities link, one expand step at a time. Your Datasets: add files, see what arrived, and choose how each is read as a graph. Place entities and routes on a map, over any Dataset with coordinates. See what the data says about each Entity Type and each Entity: how many, where, how fresh. Keep watch lists of entities, with every change on the record. See fired Alerts, and open the Investigation behind a standing detection.
